import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='BMI Category',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    alpha=0.7,
    data=df
)
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (Colored by BMI, Size by Activity Level)')
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)')
plt.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
